summary: Frank Raines (Stanislaus County): county page + WebTrac (browser; Cloudflare to curl) + imagery. OHV STAGING CAMP - drop candidate: the campground is the county's Frank Raines OHV Park camp. $30 hookup sites (29 online, $9 reservation fee), water hookups + showers + potable water restored; pin ~650 m off at the day-use area; phone/website/name flags.
flags: CRITERIA - OHV (drop candidate, reviewer decides): the camping is in the Frank Raines Off-Highway Vehicle Park, not the regional park's day-use unit. County page: 'for campers and OHV enthusiasts, the Frank Raines Off-Highway Vehicle Park is located across from the Day Use Area'; 'Dry Creek Canyon Area: Over 800 acres for off-highway vehicle recreation / Campsites / Recreation Hall'; fee schedule 'Basic Campsite at OHV: $15 / RV/Trailer Hookup Campsite at OHV: $30'; activities 'Off-Roading, Mudding, Motocross'. Imagery shows the camp ringed by OHV trails with a motocross track ~200 m west. This reads as an OHV staging/base campground (out under the off-road-parks rule), not a general campground with an OHV side. The stored note's 'adjacent Frank Raines OHV area is separate' is wrong.
PIN: stored 37.42077,-121.37270 is the Day Use Area (south of the road). The campground is ~650 m WNW: proposed 37.42300,-121.37950 (Google 'Frank Raines OHV Park' 37.42273,-121.38070).
NAME: the county sells it as 'Frank Raines Deer Creek Campground' at 'Frank Raines OHV Park'; stored 'Frank Raines Regional Park' is the umbrella park.
PHONE: stored empty -> (209) 525-6750 (Stanislaus County Parks & Recreation, on the park page and WebTrac).

SITES: WebTrac sells 29 hookup sites (01-19, 25-34; max length 37-80 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits every one); stored count 34 (derived) left - numbers 20-24 may be the $15 basic sites, which are not sold online. Electric amperage not stated anywhere read (the fee schedule says only 'Hookup').

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed; the stored evidence was read at the day-use pin. At the real camp a vegetated creek channel (Del Puerto Creek, intermittent, no water visible) runs along the north edge - no lead.
SEASON/STATUS: open (county: 'OPEN ... As of October 17, 2025'; WebTrac sells 11/27/2026). No season stated - left unset.
